intro: The menu changes with the season, the event, and what Misty is baking next. These categories show the kinds of treats Rare Treats 518 is known for without promising a fixed daily inventory.

categories.name: Cookies
categories.shortDescription: Soft, chewy, and packed with flavor.
categories.longDescription: Classic favorites, rotating flavors, decorated options, and market-ready treat bags.

categories.name: Brownies & bars
categories.shortDescription: Rich, fudgy, and made for sharing.
categories.longDescription: Brownies, blondies, layered bars, and seasonal variations sold individually or arranged for a group.

categories.name: Dessert trays
categories.shortDescription: A mixed spread for parties and gatherings.
categories.longDescription: A coordinated assortment built around the occasion, guest count, and flavors you want to serve.

categories.name: Gift bags
categories.shortDescription: A small treat with a personal touch.
categories.longDescription: Packaged sweets for birthdays, holidays, thank-you gifts, favors, and everyday surprises.

categories.name: Jars & more
categories.shortDescription: Packaged treats made for gifting or keeping.
categories.longDescription: Cookie jars, snackable assortments, and other limited ideas that change throughout the year.

categories.name: Seasonal specialties
categories.shortDescription: Limited treats for holidays and special moments.
categories.longDescription: Short-run flavors, themed packages, and occasion-specific desserts announced as they become available.
